name: gradio-chatbot
description: A minimal, start-GREEN Gradio chatbot PoC: a pure importable core (generate_reply) behind a gr.ChatInterface UI. Core/UI split so the logic is unit-testable without launching the UI or touching the network. Analytics + CDN fonts disabled (design §5.3).
interface: core.generate_reply(message: str, history: list | None = None) -> str
